events.title: US-Iran MoU expires midnight Aug 17 — Strait of Hormuz shipping grinds to halt
events.summary: The US-Iran memorandum of understanding ceasefire expires Monday Aug 17 at midnight with no replacement deal. Zero tanker transits tracked through the Strait of Hormuz on Sunday. Iran's new national security chief Mohsen Rezaie demands Washington accept Iran's conditions (unfreezing assets, end Israel's wars in Gaza and Lebanon) before Hormuz reopens. Brent crude at $89.20/barrel, up 6% last week. Trump vows to 'make Hormuz US territory'. Active war status: Day 171.

events.title: Ebola outbreak in DRC becomes deadliest in country's history — 2,325 deaths, 4,945 cases, WHO PHEIC declared
events.summary: The 2026 Ebola epidemic (Bundibugyo virus) in Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed the 2018-2020 outbreak to become the deadliest in DRC history. 4,945 confirmed cases, 2,325 deaths (47% fatality rate), 101 new cases in 24 hours as of Aug 16. No approved vaccine for Bundibugyo species. WHO warns crisis could rival West Africa 2014-2016 disaster. WHO Director-General declares Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC).

events.title: South Korean won record volatility — sharpest swings since 2009 financial crisis
events.summary: Korean won experienced record volatility, swinging from 1,555 to 1,400s against USD in just over a month. Volatility highest since 2009 global financial crisis. Won has gained ~140 per dollar since early July on bargain buying, but instability persists. India deploying $41B currency defense mechanism. EM Asia currencies under pressure from global dollar strength and geopolitical risk flows.

watch_items.title: BOJ Governor Ueda signals September rate hike; joint US-Japan yen intervention aftermath
watch_items.note: Goldman says Japan has $1T reserves for further intervention. Rate hike expected Sept. Post-intervention equilibrium fragile.

watch_items.title: ECB set to deliver final rate hike — shortest tightening drive since 2011
watch_items.note: Reuters reports ECB poised for final hike next month. Rates left unchanged June 2026 after 8 cuts.

watch_items.title: Fed at 3.50-3.75% — benign inflation but 30% probability of hike priced
watch_items.note: CPI data offered reprieve. Markets assigning 30% probability to rate hike. FOMC patient but debate unresolved.

watch_items.title: PBOC conducting overnight reverse repos Aug 14-19; pledges timely new policy rollout
watch_items.note: PBOC liquidity operations scheduled through Aug 19. Reuters reports new policy rollout pledged.

watch_items.title: Argentina central bank reform vote Aug 19; regional currency pressure
watch_items.note: Milei's BCRA charter reform aims for currency stability focus. Brazil, Colombia also under pressure.
